questions.question: In the context of microfinance in India, what is the significance of the 'Joint Liability Group (JLG)' model?
options: It provides government subsidies to support agricultural investments.
It ensures compliance with environmental sustainability standards.
It facilitates group-based lending to reduce credit risk and enhance repayment rates.
It allows MFIs to diversify their loan portfolio across multiple sectors.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (It facilitates group-based lending to reduce credit risk and enhance repayment rates.) है।

questions.question: The biological process in which characters are transferred from one generation to the other is called __________.
Which law states that the partial pressure of a gas in vapour phase varies directly with its mole fraction in the solution?

Under Article ______ of the Indian Constitution, the Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly passed the proposal to make Hindi the official language and Sanskrit the second official language of Uttarakhand state in 2010.
Who among the following was the President of the Indian National Congress session in 1885 held in Bombay?

The SDG India Index 2023-24 measured and tracked the national progress of all States and UTs on _______ indicators of the National Indicator Framework (NIF) of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
What did the term 'Mansabdar' refer to in the Mughal Empire?
options: An individual who held a position or rank
A landowner with 5000 acres of land
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (An individual who held a position or rank) है।

questions.question: How many best performing National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) cities were awarded on the occasion of International Day of Clean Air for blue skies on 7 September 2024 in Jaipur?
How many medals did Preethi Pal win in Athletics at the Paris 2024 Paralympics?
Which of the following non-farming employments is related to Operation Flood?
Which region was part of Ashoka's empire and later saw the emergence of kingdoms after the decline of the Mauryan rule?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The Deccan and Kalinga) है।

questions.question: A dance form that takes its name from the mythical character Mohini belongs to which state?
Since 1986, the IUCN has listed the Indian Bison in which category due to its declining population?
The National Commission for Scheduled Castes consists of 1 Chairman, ______ Vice Chairman/Chairmen, and ______ members.
In the context of income distribution, what does the Lorenz curve measure?
options: The concentration of wealth among the wealthiest individuals in society
The proportion of income earned by different quintiles of the population
The total income generated within a country's economy
The degree of income inequality within a society
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The degree of income inequality within a society) है।

questions.question: How many schedules were there in the original version of the Indian Constitution at the time of commencement?

As per the report of the Technical Group on Population Estimates constituted by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, youth in the age group of 15-29 years constitute what percentage of the population in 2021?
According to Köppen classification, what type of climate does Arunachal Pradesh experience?
options: Dfc – Cold humid winter with short summer
Amw – Monsoon with short dry season
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Dfc – Cold humid winter with short summer) है।

questions.question: The famous book 'Patliputra Ki Samagri' is related to ________.
The Governor of a state will address his resignation to the __________________.
options: Chief Minister of the concerned state
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (President of India) है।
